record.paper_title: Billiard dynamics: A survey with the emphasis on open problems
record.original_question: Is every integrable planar Birkhoff billiard table necessarily an ellipse? Here a Birkhoff billiard table is a bounded planar billiard table with smooth strictly convex boundary, and “integrable” means that the union of invariant circles of the billiard map in phase space has nonempty interior.

evidence.quote: Задача 1. Эллипсы — это единственные интегрируемые биллиардные столы.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^2$ be a bounded planar domain whose boundary $\partial\Omega$ is a smooth, strictly convex Jordan curve. Consider the billiard map $T$ associated with $\Omega$, defined on the phase space of unit tangent vectors based at boundary points and pointing inward, where $T$ sends an incoming trajectory to the next boundary collision after specular reflection (angle of incidence equals angle of reflection). An invariant circle of $T$ is a homotopically nontrivial $T$-invariant continuous curve in the phase space. Call the billiard in $\Omega$ integrable if the union of all invariant circles of $T$ has nonempty interior in the phase space.

Prove or disprove: every such integrable billiard table $\Omega$ is an ellipse.
artifact.status_search_result: The Birkhoff (Birkhoff–Poritsky) conjecture remains open in full generality. Significant partial results are known: a complete proof of the polynomial version (Bialy–Mironov, Glutsyuk); a local/perturbative version near ellipses of small eccentricity (Avila–De Simoi–Kaloshin; Kaloshin–Sorrentino); a non-perturbative result for centrally symmetric convex domains (Bialy–Mironov); and a perturbative version near centrally symmetric domains (Kaloshin et al., 2024). The general conjecture is still unresolved as of 2024–2026.

status_evidence.title: Birkhoff Conjecture for nearly centrally symmetric domains
status_evidence.snippet: A domain close enough to a centrally symmetric one with integrable billiard is an ellipse.
status_evidence.claim: Perturbative Birkhoff conjecture proved near centrally symmetric domains (2024).

status_evidence.title: On the local Birkhoff conjecture for convex billiards
status_evidence.snippet: Local Birkhoff conjecture proved for perturbations of ellipses of small eccentricity.
status_evidence.claim: Local version of the conjecture is established.

status_evidence.title: On polynomially integrable Birkhoff billiards on surfaces of constant curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Solution of the polynomial version of the Birkhoff conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Integrable Billiards and Related Topics
status_evidence.snippet: In general the Birkhoff conjecture still remains open.
